hypothesis: C14-C16 and Test A/B/C failed semantic retrieval under sparse selected-site routing. interpretation: Passing C17 permits a new process-prior held-out experiment; it does not qualify MI1 or establish generalization. Failure leaves the bank contents and task form unchanged while removing sparse layer/head access as the remaining tested explanation.
